profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Los Angeles Metro 👷🏽‍♂️🚃
profile.summary:
👋🏼 Hey! I'm Julio,

a software and embedded engineer with three years of experience and an additional four years of design engineering experience. 

Currently, I’m an engineer at LA Metro’s Rail Operations Control Center (ROCC) contributing to the most extensive expansion of passenger rail in the country.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · On-site

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
◦ Engineered a comprehensive system encompassing a cryogenic materials registry, batching system, and point-of-sale (POS) software. Integrated multiple sensors and input/output components, leveraging C++ embedded expertise. Simultaneously, crafted an intuitive tablet-based graphical user interface (GUI). Setting a new industry standard and driving modernization within the Cryogenic market.
◦ Utilized React Native in conjunction with an array of AWS tools to conceive, develop, and sustain robust mobile applications, revolutionizing engine controls for the contemporary age. Engineered features including multi-engine controls, streamlined engine cards, and pump reassignment, enhancing user experience. Proficiently managed backend operations, encompassing the creation and maintenance of Lambda functions and MongoDB databases.
◦ Collaborated closely with firmware engineers throughout the entire project lifecycle to effectively manage the integration of complex IoT systems, from initial ideation and prototyping to the final deployment phase, ensuring seamless functionality and successful project outcomes.
◦ Technology Utilized: JavaScript, React Native, Expo, Node.js, AWS, C++, CAN, J1939.
positions.insights: Skills: Internet of Things (IoT) · Embedded Software Programming · User Interface Design · Mobile Applications · CAN bus · React Native · JavaScript · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · J1939 · C++

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
◦ Built food delivery web & mobile application for restaurant businesses to replace existing subscription based food delivery apps (Doordash, Uber Eats, Grubhub) to decrease delivery commission fees, increase control over online presence & increase profit margins over 35%.
◦ Developed UI/UX strategies which include wire frames and mock-ups and for small and medium-sized enterprises.
◦ Worked closely with clients to gather requirements and ensure their vision was brought to life. Developed 5+ websites for
small businesses, each with unique designs and features.
◦ Optimized website speed and reduced loading time by 50%, improving customer satisfaction and leading to significant
increase in page rankings.
◦ Performed on-page SEO optimizations resulting in a 30% increase in organic traffic.
◦ Key Clients: wanaiguana.com, candebuild.com
◦ Technology Utilized: JavaScript, Python, Flask, mySQL, Express.js, HTML, CSS, Bootstrap.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Flask · JavaScript · MySQL · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
◦ Developed web application alongside a small team of four engineers to replace existing solution to input and categorize control center incident logs and generate end of the day reports.
◦ Integrated rich text editor into application, adding over a dozen text functions, increasing ability to create custom and detail oriented reports by using Quill.js tool.
◦ Implemented ability to add frequently used templates to incident logs with keyboard shortcuts reducing input time by utilizing keyboard bindings.
◦ Integrated the ability to rapidly add search tags to incident log entries by using text auto-complete function improving data storage for optimal categorization and search-ability.
◦ Created database to store incident logs using SQL Alchemy and created tool to search through database with various criteria and display data in a quick and efficient manner.
◦ Technology Utilized: Python Language, Flask Framework, SQLAlchemy, Bycrpt, HTML, JavaScript, Quill.js, Awesomplete, Cleave.js.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · SQL · Front-End Development · Flask · JavaScript · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Design Engineer
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
◦ Created detailed drawings for projects using CAD software, based on sketches, field measurements, or verbal instructions. This involved conceptual development, mechanical design, general arrangement, detail views, and construction layouts.
◦ Prepared and submitted finalized plans to local government agencies for approval, and facilitated subsequent alterations and corrections throughout the permitting process.
◦ Served as a project manager for specific procurement and construction projects, overseeing the work of contractor personnel and ensuring that plans based on prepared drawings were properly executed.
◦ Organizes and maintains comprehensive records of engineering drawings, equipment, and vendor files, ensuring accuracy and completeness. Prints drawings as needed for personnel, contractors, and vendors, while also organizing and maintaining microfilm records and indexes for drawings and files.
◦ Conducted research and analysis to improve existing designs and optimize processes, resulting in a 20% increase in design and modeling efficiency.
positions.insights: Skills: Computer-Aided Design (CAD) · SU Podium · SketchUp · AutoCAD · Adobe Creative Suite · V-Ray

positions.title: Architectural Drafter
positions.description:
◦ Created concept sketches for various outdoor event centers, including La Plaza, The Hispanic Center, and The Johnson Foundation Center, to provide visual representations of design ideas and guide the development process.
◦ Utilized computer-aided drafting software to design and draft 2D blueprints and 3D models for large-scale construction projects, enabling precise visualization and communication of complex design concepts.
◦ Collaborated with engineers and construction managers on-site to ensure successful project completion, while maintaining the original design concept.
positions.insights: Skills: Revit · AutoCAD · Civil Engineering · ARCHICAD

positions.title: 3D Modeler
positions.description:
◦ Created exterior renderings to illustrate the different stages of the remodel process, from inception to final completion.
◦ Produced comprehensive before-and-after models of the City of Lancaster building, highlighting changes in trimming,
exterior materials, light fixtures, bench designs, and landscape.
◦ Collaborated with the City of Lancaster Parks and Recreation department to co-create and fabricate 3D models, featuring customized bench designs, light fixtures, and window work.
positions.insights: Skills: Computer-Aided Design (CAD) · Architectural Design · SketchUp · 3D Modeling · V-Ray
